title: Ring beam: T1a variations
desc: Three new builds of 840 T1a (hex prism + spark rings): twin counter-turning prisms with corner streak waves, a breathing prism launching hex spark hoops, and a flared ratchet prism with orbiting spark rings.

takes.name: twin hex prisms + corner streak waves
takes.facts: thin fast inner and wide slow outer hex prism turning against each other; rings of 6 streaks shot from the outer prism's corners, firing down the beam like a wave

takes.name: breathing hex prism + hex spark hoops
takes.facts: hex prism swells on a 6-tick beat; each beat launches a hexagonal hoop of 18 sparks down the beam, widening, breaking up at the wall

takes.name: flared ratchet prism + orbiting spark rings
takes.facts: hex prism flares thin-to-wide and snaps round 30 degrees every 5 ticks; rings of 6 sparks orbit as they travel, then fling off
